comments.story: Were Early Modern People Perpetually Drunk? (2016)
comments.why: BBC extract showing monkeys' drinking categories.
comments.text: Actually, some monkeys develop alcohol dependence in the wild (they get their alcohol from ripe fermenting fruits). Source: [LINK] Here's also an extract from a BBC Nature documentary: [VIDEO] Apparently, the monkeys are divided among heavy drinkers, occasional drinkers or teetootalers in proportions that are roughly equal to those among human beings.
